newsitem.title: USA: Conrail sets Dec 19, 1997 meeting date.
newsitem.headline: Conrail sets Dec 19, 1997 meeting date.

text.p: Conrail Inc said on Friday that it has set its 1997 annual meeting date for December 19, 1997, if a meeting is required.
Conrail said it will devote its energies to seeking approval of its merger with CSX Corp and the U.S. Surface Transportation Board.
If shareholder approval is obtained for the CSX deal, the merger will proceed and no annual shareholder meeting will be necessary, Conrail said.
Conrail chief executive David LeVan met earlier today with the chief executives of CSX Corp and Norfolk Southern Corp, a rival bidder for Conrail.
The companies declined to reveal any details of the meeting, which centered on competitive issues in the railroad industry. The three railroads operate in the Eastern United States.
